python3 -B -c 'import pathlib,http.client,json,sys; t=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config/tgtumbler/tumblr-operation-app/tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip(); p=8081
def call(m,path,token=None):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",p,timeout=8); h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token} if token else {}; c.request(m,path,headers=h);r=c.getresponse();o=(r.status,r.read(500000));c.close();return o
try:
 h,b=call("GET","/healthz");assert h==200 and json.loads(b)["commit"]=="c0de1bffeb4c9f829288cb30f50d319b21980b81","REVISION"
 h,b=call("GET","/");assert h==401,"UNAUTH_SCREEN"
 h,b=call("GET","/",t);assert h==200 and b"id=\"tumblr-connect\"" in b,"AUTH_SCREEN"
 h,b=call("GET","/oauth/status");assert h==401,"STATUS_AUTH"
 h,b=call("POST","/oauth/start");assert h==401,"START_AUTH"
 h,b=call("GET","/app.js",t);assert h==200 and b"/oauth/configure" in b and b"/oauth/start" in b,"CLIENT_JS"
 h,b=call("GET","/styles.css",t);assert h==200 and b"#tumblr-connect" in b,"CLIENT_STYLE"
 h,b=call("GET","/oauth/status",t);assert h==200 and isinstance(json.loads(b).get("connected"),bool),"STATUS_ENDPOINT"
 print("ACTION=ACCOUNT_OAUTH_RUNTIME_READBACK");print("REVISION=PASS");print("LOGIN_GUARD=PASS");print("OAUTH_ENTRY=PASS");print("CLIENT_UI=PASS");print("VERIFY=PASS")
except Exception as e:
 print("ACTION=ACCOUNT_OAUTH_RUNTIME_READBACK");print("VERIFY=FAIL");print("CHECK="+str(e).splitlines()[0][:48]);sys.exit(41)'
